name: Friedrich Heitzler

events.title: Death away from home
events.description: Died at 5 p.m. and buried 18 Dec 1865 at 9:30 a.m. by the Catholic vicar. Described as 'Bürger von Munzingen', aged 56 (margin: 56 y 9 m 7 d). Witnesses were the head teacher Carl M[öser?] and the gravedigger Friedrich K[rebs?] of the same place. The notice was sent from the evangelical pfarramt there to Munzingen and entered as Todtenbuch 1866 No. 1a. The extract was signed at H[öllstein?] on 18 Dec 1865 by the Catholic Pfarrvikariat.

bioAdditions: Friedrich died far from Munzingen. A notice from the Protestant parish of a place read here as Brombach, in the Wiese valley near Lörrach, informed the Catholic parish of Munzingen that 'Friedrich Heitzler, Bürger von Munzingen', had died there at five in the evening of 15 Dec 1865. The Catholic vicar buried him on 18 December. Munzingen entered the extract at the head of its 1866 death register as No. 1a (S1). The margin gives his age as 56 years, 9 months and 7 days, which counts back exactly to his known birth on 8 Mar 1809. The place name and the names of the witnesses are hard to read; an earlier reading of the place was Lörrach. Why a Munzingen day labourer and former gravedigger was in the Lörrach district is unknown. He may have been working on the railway or in the Wiesental textile mills.
